integrity_notes: Analytic proof supports all integer \(n\ge3\) and real \(t\ge0\). Finite script tests are independent spot checks, not an infinite-family proof. Potential specialized unindexed prior coverage remains; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The spectral Max-Cut SDP equivalence on vertex-transitive graphs is known; the finding is the combined exact integer phase, distinct transitions, unique rank-two optimal Gram matrix, worst-gap location, and deterministic hyperplane rounding. Only uniform positive cycle weights and one common nonnegative antipodal-edge weight are covered. No claim is made at the nonunique SDP transition for arbitrary rounding factors.
title: Two sharp Max-Cut transitions and exact hyperplane rounding on weighted Möbius ladders
